title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a G-code viewer picture to Session 2
body:
## Problem
Students write G-code but never see it drawn by a tool other than their own parser.

## Context
Checking a program with a second tool is part of good practice.

## Expected outcome
A short section and a screenshot showing the Session 2 pocket program in a free G-code viewer, with a note on any difference in the time estimate.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Screenshot and one paragraph added
- [ ] The note states that real machines need trained operators and safety checks

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: offset any convex polygon
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet: offsets are only implemented for rectangles.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-02/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: contour-parallel pocket with a boss
body:
## Problem
Session 3 clears the boss pocket with a raster that lifts over the boss; rings that bend round it would be faster.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app that build rings from the distance-to-wall field and report time and removed volume.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Roadmap checkpoint met (time and volume)
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: planner and simulator with counters
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows rings round two bosses, chip counters and a trade-off curve; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Rest machining reduces the corner leftover as in the roadmap
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
